alerts.label: Pool Closure: Dec 14–18
alerts.text: Due to annual cleaning and maintenance, the pool and aquatics facility at Ryan Family YMCA will be closed from Monday, December 14 through Friday December 18, 2026.

alerts.label: THANKSGIVING DAY HOURS
alerts.text:
Please note that all branches will be open with limited hours from 7:00am-10:00am on Thursday, November 26, 2026.
We wish everyone a safe and happy holiday!

notes: Family swim is available at all times, space is subject to availability based on programming.
Recommended times: MON-THURS 5:30-4:00PM, after 6:00PM, FRI after 5:00PM, SAT & SUN all day.
Our Annual Pool closure for Maintenance is scheduled beginning on 12/14 with an anticipated reopening of 12/18.
Beginning 12/14, our Therapy pool will be getting replastered & other upgrades which will cause it to be closed until approximately late January.
